Package com.github.crittscott.somestacks.gametest

Class ProtectionGameTests

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somestacks.gametest.ProtectionGameTests
All Implemented Interfaces:
net.fabricmc.fabric.api.gametest.v1.FabricGameTest
public final class ProtectionGameTests extends Object implements net.fabricmc.fabric.api.gametest.v1.FabricGameTest
The rules that keep a gesture from writing where it should not: build height, entity obstruction, destination consultation, actor-preserving cleanup, and growth checks in simulation and commit.

    • destinationConsultationRunsBeforePlacement

      public void destinationConsultationRunsBeforePlacement(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      To reproduce in-game: stand outside a claim and click toward a denied destination inside it. Fabric consults that destination while it is still air and places nothing there.

    • playerExtractionUsesPlayerForCleanup

      public void playerExtractionUsesPlayerForCleanup(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      To reproduce in-game: allow a player but deny [SomeStacks] in a claim, then have the player extract the last Single. Player-attributed cleanup removes the empty block.

    • playerStorageSettlementUsesPlayerForCleanup

      public void playerStorageSettlementUsesPlayerForCleanup(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      To reproduce in-game: allow a player but deny [SomeStacks] in a claim, then have the player extract the last Storage item. Deferred cleanup retains the player and removes the block.

    • settleKeepsAnEmptyTopBlockWhoseRemovalIsRefused

      public void settleKeepsAnEmptyTopBlockWhoseRemovalIsRefused(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      A refused cleanup leaves the empty top Storage block in both the world and the resolved run. To reproduce in-game: protect the top block of a two-block temporary Storage pile from [SomeStacks], leave one item in the bottom block, and trigger settlement. The protected empty top block remains; after allowing [SomeStacks], the next settlement removes it.

    • adjacentConsultationHonorsProtectionQuery

      public void adjacentConsultationHonorsProtectionQuery(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      A Common Protection API denial vetoes an adjacent-stack consultation. To reproduce in-game: deny item use at a claimed destination, then hold the modifier and right-click the neighboring block toward it. No item is deposited and no stack is placed in the denied position.

    • refusedRemovalStillLetsTheBarsAboveComeDown

      public void refusedRemovalStillLetsTheBarsAboveComeDown(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      A refused removal keeps an emptied Bar block without preventing the unsupported block above from collapsing. To reproduce in-game: build a supported two-block Bar column, deny [SomeStacks] permission to remove the lower block, and extract its bottom support. The empty lower block remains, while the unsupported upper block comes down.
